execute_trade_buy: execute a trade to buy shares of a ticker using the TradeExecutor class with a portfolio
execute_trade_sell: execute a trade to sell shares of a ticker using the TradeExecutor class with a portfolio
execute_trade_short: execute a trade to open a short position on a ticker using the TradeExecutor class with a portfolio
execute_trade_cover: execute a trade to cover a short position on a ticker using the TradeExecutor class with a portfolio
execute_trade_hold: execute a hold action with the TradeExecutor class to skip trading for a ticker
